intent.problem: Monitor a live CCTV stream without sending its native frame rate to the model.

safety.reason: An uncertain frame requires operator approval before detailed analysis; notable confirmed findings still surface as notices.

intent.target_users: Video operators, security reviewers, safety operations teams, and site-access coordinators.

capabilities: Try the included demo or connect one approved RTSP/RTMP camera stream.
Keeps camera credentials out of logs and public reports.
Flags notable visual changes for review without taking physical security action.
Leaves safety, security, access, and disciplinary decisions to you.
Shows live activity and accepts monitoring instructions through Chat.

product.agent_role: Co-worker for reviewing live camera activity and preparing alerts.
product.benefit: Focus your attention on notable changes in a live camera feed, with frames and observations you can review.
product.customizable_for: Video monitoring, configurable visual detection, facility operations, and site safety workflows.
product.how_it_works: Checks the stream at regular intervals and takes a closer look when the scene changes. You can change what it watches for or request an analysis through Chat.
product.input: The included demo stream or one approved RTSP/RTMP camera stream, plus what to watch for and your alert settings.
product.output: Live video preview, analyzed frames, activity observations, alerts, and reports for review.

overview: Reviews a live camera stream, highlights notable activity, and prepares observations for your review. Start with the included demo or connect an approved camera stream. Requires an NVIDIA GPU.
